scope: Headless Chromium against a local Vite server; all API responses synthetic, all unrelated writes aborted. UI evidence only, not backend authorization or actual backup/restore execution.
fixtureLimitation: The ad hoc browser scripts were created in /tmp and are not committed; command names identify this run, not a reproducible repository test suite.

supportAndBreakGlassUi.nonOwnerAndExpired: Metadata tab absent; zero customer resource GETs in both cases.
supportAndBreakGlassUi.breakGlass: Requester with synthetic canApprove=true has no approve action; different approver sees action and confirmation remains disabled for empty or wrong-case name, enabled for exact name.

databaseRestoreUi.result: Each configured-target new-database flow sent one synthetic successful precheck and one intercepted execution only after confirmation; execution included matching precheckId, NewDatabase mode, expected port 1433/5432, and no overwrite confirmation. Navigated to synthetic execution detail.
databaseRestoreUi.notCovered: No real database, failed precheck, or overwrite path exercised in this new browser run; prior component tests cover general failed/stale precheck and MSSQL-style typed overwrite, but PostgreSQL overwrite was not specifically exercised end-to-end.

existingEvidence.jobCreateEdit: Prior passing backup-job-wizard-page.test.tsx covers PostgreSQL job request, edit copy-only migration, file configuration, source validation and server field errors; prior fixture route tour checks rendering only, not successful persistence.
existingEvidence.fileRestore: audit-file-restore-fixture.json records mocked selection validation, failed/successful precheck, stale check invalidation, overwrite name, focus trap, execution errors and synthetic navigation.
existingEvidence.storageReplication: Prior passing multi-destination-picker.test.tsx and replication.test.tsx exercise selection and degraded/failed replica reporting; no actual provider write or replication was executed in this run.
existingEvidence.download: Prior passing artifact-download.test.tsx covers native download URL, Owner/Admin gating, errors and permission revocation; this run checks role-gated button visibility, not file bytes.
existingEvidence.supportBreakGlass: Prior passing platform-support-session-page.test.tsx, support/restore-form.test.tsx, break-glass-detail.test.tsx and platform-break-glass-pages.test.tsx cover permission combinations, precheck invalidation, self-approval refusal and typed confirmation with mocked APIs.

securityLimitations: Synthetic responses cannot establish server-side role enforcement, cross-tenant isolation, support permission checks, self-approval prevention or single-use break-glass enforcement. No live writes or direct authorization probes were made.
